nodes.label: Register Page Mockup
nodes.description: UI mockup of the SEMD (Suspicious-URL Evaluation for Malicious Detection) sign-up screen, shown inside a browser chrome frame. Split-screen layout: the left ~55% is a yellow/cream brand panel showing the SEMD logo (a cartoon detective cat with hat and magnifying glass), the tagline 'Suspicious-URL Evaluation for Malicious Detection', and a preview data table of reported URLs with columns ID, URL, Reported at, Type (Malicious/Safe badges), Verify (Checked/Pending badges), and Reported by (avatar + username, including a 'system' entry) — reused as a background/preview behind the auth form. The right ~30% is a white card titled in Thai 'สมัครสมาชิก' (Register) with greeting text 'สวัสดีสมาชิกใหม่ มาเริ่มต้นกันเลย', and a form containing: Username field (ระบุชื่อผู้ใช้งาน) with user icon, Email field (อีเมลล์) with placeholder 'semd@msu.ac.th', Password field (รหัสผ่าน) with masked input and show/hide icon, Confirm Password field (ยืนยันรหัสผ่าน) with show/hide icon, a solid orange 'สมัครสมาชิก' (Register) submit button, a divider labeled 'หรือ' (or), social sign-up buttons for Google ('ดำเนินการต่อด้วย Google') and GitHub, a link 'มีบัญชีอยู่แล้ว? เข้าสู่ระบบเลย' (Already have an account? Log in) pointing to the login page, and a Google reCAPTCHA badge at the bottom. Design uses a warm orange/cream color scheme consistent with the SEMD brand identity.
